It’s finally here!  After years of hard work, passion, and dedication we present to you:  [h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2354770/Oni_Onsen/]Oni Onsen – Now With Full Voice Acting![/url][/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2354770/Oni_Onsen/]Grab it on Steam Here[/url]

A gorgeous gay dating sim where you date hunky oni in feudal era Japan! The only way the cursed oni can get free from the onsen is by seducing the sexy samurai Asano! A yaoi, bara, bl, lgbtq+, queer visual novel!

[list]
[*] FULL VOICE ACTING!! With Advanced Settings Where You Can Adjust Volumes For Each Character and Mute Any You Don’t Like!
[*] Four Oni Love Interests!
[*] 20 Hours of Game Play!
[*] An Original Traditional Japanese Themed Sound Track!
[*] 23 Beautifully Drawn Images, With Numerous Variations!
[*] A Fun, Dramatic, Touching, Quirky, and Anime-ish Story!
[*] Three Love Stories per Route! Side Characters Mina and Sakuna Date the Oni Too!
[*] A Bonus Ninja Love Story for Aku in the Nensu Route! (Sponsored by a Supporter for Everyone to Enjoy!)
[*] Four Sakuna/Oni Sex Scenes!
[*] A Mostly Kinetic (Fewer Choice Interruptions in the Narrative) Anime-Style Story with 13 Different Endings!
[*] Over 20 Beautifully Painted Backgrounds!
[/list]
[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2354770/Oni_Onsen/]Grab Oni Onsen NOW To Catch The Launch Discount![/url][/h1]

notes.title: Small Patch Done!
notes.content: [p]Thanks to all of you who helped us have a great game launch!  We've finished our first patch to address a few issues all of you brought up, such as there not being a volume control for Nensu, and an error with the help screen.  Not as many issues as we expected![/p][p]We hope you love Oni Onsen.  We truly put our hearts into this game.  While we could have finished sooner, we knew full voice acting would bring this game up to the potential it deserved.  We hope you enjoy it![/p][p]Now let's get enough wishlists to make Polyamory![/p]
